query.selection: REG live pass/run; excludes kneels, spikes, two-point attempts and no-play/special teams using current schematic selection helper. Physical outcome cohort requires penalty flag=false. Missing flags/gains remain audited.
query.throws: Recorded completion/incompletion/interception among dropbacks, sacks excluded; includes throwaways. Interception return yards are not offensive pass yards.
query.yardage: Primary whole-play yards_gained; also separately report finite credited passing_yards. Dropbacks include sacks/scrambles; designed runs exclude them. Completions and YAC have separate populations and known-value n.
query.success: Known gain, valid down1-4 and positive finite ydstogo; >=40% first,60% second,100% third/fourth. Turnover gains remain yard success; this is not EPA success.
query.TD: pass_touchdown per recorded throw; rush_touchdown per designed run; pass_touchdown OR rush_touchdown per dropback; require known applicable flags. Generic touchdown can be a defensive score and is not used.
query.tails: Interpolated p10/25/50/75/90/95/99 and max; 10/20/30/40+ known whole-gain rates and field-eligible rates; YAC10/20/40+ among known-YAC completions. Goal-shortened gains remain observed, not invented potential yards.
query.cells: Current rushing benchmark down/distance/field bins. Calling share keeps live flagged rows; cell physical outcomes use penalty=false. Every metric has its own count/denominator; <40 clean plays marked sparse, not silently broadened.
query.variation: Equal-weight observed team-season estimates, pooled64 and each season32; descriptive population variation, not independent trials, confidence intervals, talent-isolated effects or generated-roster limits.
query.FTN: Exact game/play join; separate 2022/23 missingness and known-label denominators. Label outcomes, catchability, out-of-pocket, hit/rusher/blitzer associations are descriptive and cannot identify causes of drops/inaccuracy or all pressure. FTN Data via nflverse; charted derived aggregates CC-BY-SA-4.0.
query.reserved: No 2026 PBP/tracking or reserved weeks read. No network or engine changes.

definitions.selection: Native live run/pass; excludes nullified plays AND all foul flags, including declined fouls. NFL reference requires penalty=false; kneel/spike/two-point absent from native sidecar.
definitions.mapping: Native pass kind is dropback; sack/scramble flags retained. Recorded throws require attempted=true, throw/throwaway event, final completion/incompletion/interception, no sack/scramble. INT has priority. REG is classifier compatibility, not a claim simulated games are NFL games.
definitions.yards: Official native offensive whole-play yards, including turnover offenseYards. YPA/YPC here mean wholePlayYardsPerThrow/Completion; credited NFL passing_yards is a distinct unavailable native statistic.
definitions.TD: Actual touchdown event team=O. Specific pass/rush TD attribution unavailable after an offensive fumble; offensive TD remains known. Defensive touchdowns excluded.
definitions.success: Exact shared nfl-outcomes.py success operator: finite gain, down1-4, positive distance,40/60/100. Turnover gain remains yard-only success; EPA is unavailable.
definitions.pressure: Exact metrics.py pass_metrics operator on paired common tracking; native pressured flag separate. Unknown remains unknown. Association cannot identify pressure-caused inaccuracy or decision error.
definitions.categories: Final INT, completion, drop, PBU, throwaway, other incomplete, in that order. Overlapping native labels/events describe outcomes, not causal accuracy.
definitions.cells: Existing rushing down/distance/field bins; NFL cell references by same key and season, no fitting or sparse-cell averaging.
definitions.cohorts: Each cohort has its own generated roster pair, held across its declared games. Different cohort seeds are not matched counterfactual games. Per-game scores include special teams and flagged plays; clean outcome subsets do not.

interceptionPaths.limitation: Recorded event pathways, not identified QB-error causes or NFL position-matched rates.

contextStandardization.weights: Pooled NFL metric-specific denominator weights on each panel's common down/distance/field support; identical weights for both sides.
contextStandardization.limitations: Descriptive only; per-cohort support differs. Talent, concepts, coverage, opponent, score/clock and selection into completions remain uncontrolled. Native runs are RB/FB here; all NFL designed carriers remain in the run comparison. Thin cells excluded, not broadened. No quantile averaging, causal claim, confidence interval or tuning target.

definitions.pass.pressure_2yd_before_throw: Share of dropbacks with a defender within 2 yd of the QB between 0.5 s and the throw (or 4 s).
definitions.contact.run|catch.*: From the carrier's first contact (run: RB; catch: receiver after the catch): entry speed, speed 0.5 s later, yards after contact (also by entry speed: slow < 3, mid < 5.5, fast yd/s), contact to whistle.
definitions.air.*: Ball in the air, targeted receiver: air time, depth where the ball arrives, nearest defender at the throw and at arrival, and how much that gap closed.
definitions.contact.*.tackler_speed_at_contact: Speed of the defender nearest the carrier at first contact (stand-in for the first tackler).
definitions.contact.*.approach_headon: Share of contacts where carrier and tackler move against each other (velocity angle > 120 deg); yards_after_contact@headon|side|behind splits by that angle.
definitions.contact.*.broke_contact: Share of contacts after which the carrier is still running >= 4 yd/s half a second later and gains >= 5 more yards (tracking proxy for a broken tackle).
definitions.route.separation_Ns: Before the throw, each WR/TE/RB at least 3 yd downfield: distance to the nearest defender.
definitions.catch.*: Completed passes: actual catcher's depth, speed and yards after catch. Uses receiver when present; inputs without that channel fall back to target.
definitions.run.*@family: The same run metric within one concept family (inside_zone, outside_zone, gap_pull, man_duo, draw).

tracking.audit: 310 overlapping cells, not independent tests. Full audit output-pinned above. Native clean outcomes and non-null common plays are separate populations.

query.selection: Common kind=pass, non-nullified by exporter, explicit catch event and valid intended-target index. Retain all gains, receiver groups, contact labels and penalties allowed by common producer. Do not filter on gain, coverage, contact or outcome. Catch-recipient mismatch remains a flagged operator limitation.
query.random: One Python random.Random(20261011); cohorts101 then202; numeric game-seed and play-number sorted pools; sample without replacement24; fail if fewer than24 or duplicate IDs. Publish selected IDs before reviewing selected paths.
query.review: Near catch<=2yd; middle>2<=5yd; far>5yd from actual caught receiver to nearest defender at rounded catch frame. Describe sampled path beforecatch(.4/.2) and aftercatch(.2/.4/.6/.8/1.2), persistent nearest-at-catch player plus nearest-now. Measured velocity uses shared0.4s central difference; this is not native request, support or gaze.
query.contactTaxonomy: No recorded postcatch contact; first-event opponent body collision; grasp/wrap; hit/tackle fallback. Preserve first-wrap distance/angle/entry speeds separately if available. A contact event is not a grip; no recorded event is not proof of no solved contact. Check prior QB/global firstContactX suppression and intended-vs-actual recipient.
query.angle: At first recorded contact, persistent first event actor ifknown, otherwise shared nearest-defender proxy. Velocity angle only when bothspeeds>1yd/s: headon cosine<-.5,behind>.5,else side; slow/unavailable separate. Never substitute bodyfacing for eyes.
query.rubric: Observed precontact spacing/base problem; approach/overshoot needing cue trace; actual acquired-grip sequence needing load trace; blocked legitimate recovery; insufficientlight evidence/no clear wrong mechanism. No physical-defect declaration from a gain or proxy alone.
query.limits: Oldb116 top16YAC tails and historicalcontroller witnesses were already inspected. This new uniform sample is not strict outcome-blinding or independent coach adjudication.48 native completions/two generated roster pairs cannot establish league-wide fault frequencies. No physics/controller/rating edits or new full-game runs by this reviewer.

summary.limits: Counts are descriptive categories of this48completion engineering review; nominations overlap and are not bug/miss/grip-failure rates. All requested IDs preserved. No outcome rerolls, command/force/perception state or independent expert coach adjudication.

randomCompletionReview.rank: Precontact picture/request10; acquisition/support6; overlap2. Zero confirmed wrong requests/physical faults from light film. Targeted completion sample supplements all-snap review.

measurementRepairs.liveWindow: Event inside recording AND whistle; no extrapolation. Removes20Hz half-grid selection bias.96 contact summaries changed; noncontact/playcounts unchanged.

receiver.stage: Both current cohorts and pooled2193 common plays measured; historical receiver limitations retained.
receiver.operator: catch context uses raw.receiver when present, otherwise raw.target; air/route/pressure retain intended target.
receiver.nflEffect: All four NFL adapters omit receiver. Therefore the fallback reads exactly the previous official/inferred target, with all numeric catch calculations identical. Live-window equivalence holds on their10Hz event grid as above.
receiver.historicalCatchRangeLimit: Three prior saved sim common packets also omit receiver, but have no recovered raw catch-actor sidecars. Their numeric catch summaries are retained as legacy intended-target evidence, excluded from corrected actual-catcher ranges.
receiver.definitionNote: Legacy inputs fall back to target, which can differ from actual catcher on older sim packets; no official-catcher claim for those histories.

NFLAdmission.method: Adapter grid proof, not a raw-play rerun. No saved NFL common packets were located.
NFLAdmission.proof: For t=m/10 with nonnegative integer m and dt=.1, nearest-frame k(t) is min(m,lastFrame). Therefore the old condition k(t)*dt>=t-epsilon and the new condition t<=lastFrame*dt+epsilon both admit exactly m<=lastFrame. Whistle admission is unchanged; the half-second query adds five integer frames. All existing live callers query either fixed integer frames or these event-grid times. Floating point drift is below the shared 1e-9 tolerance for recorded play windows. The additional nonnegative condition changes no adapter event.
NFLAdmission.unitCheck: test_nfl_integer_frame_event_admission_is_unchanged: frames1,2,6,41,801; whistle before/at/after recording; every event frame through ten trailing frames.
